description: Leakage-safe deterministic train/validation/test splits for Chichewa Corpus v0.1. Tokenizer training must use train only.

assignment.note: group_id is hashed with salt via SHA-256; first 8 bytes interpreted as big-endian uint64; bucket = value % modulus. Train [0, train_end), validation [train_end, val_end), test [val_end, modulus).

grouping.rationale: Book/chapter/verse and Wikipedia article boundaries are not preserved in the processed corpus. documents.jsonl is line-level only (source_id:line_index). No blank-line article separators remain. Do not invent structural metadata.

bible.limitation: VPL book/chapter/verse markers were stripped before or during raw placement; processed bible.txt is sequential verse-like lines without recoverable identifiers.

wikipedia.limitation: Article boundaries were not retained through extraction/cleaning; documents.jsonl has no article IDs; no blank-line document separators remain.

disclaimers: Do not train tokenizers or models on validation or test.
Contiguous blocks are a leakage-reduction fallback, not recovered Bible chapters or Wikipedia articles.
Formulaic religious phrasing may yield high shingle overlap without exact-line leakage.
